تقتضبن (form VIII)
# تَقْتَضِبْنَ (taqtaḍibna) /taq.ta.dˤib.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
# تُقْتَضَبْنَ (tuqtaḍabna) /tuq.ta.dˤab.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
